descriptions.preferred: Acer paxii Evergreen Japanese Maple Zones 7b-10 Acer paxii is an extremely rare maple from Yunan, China. This selection is evergreen in warmer climates, while semi-deciduous in colder climates. In these colder climates, you may get yellow and coral pink fall color later than other maples. New growth can be a beautiful coral pink with leaves that will remind you of Acer buergerianum. This evergreen is in fact a close relative to the trident maple, being grouped in section Pentaphylla. Acer paxii may reach 15-20 ft in 10 years. Give Acer paxii protection from the hot afternoon sun in warmer climates. This is a chance to get a really rare acer to add that bit of exclusivity to your garden.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer paxii 金沙槭，适生区 7b-10。 Acer paxii 是来自中国云南的极稀有槭树。 在较温暖地区，该品种为常绿；在较冷地区则表现为半落叶。 于这些较冷地区，其秋色可能较其他槭树来得更晚，可呈黄色和珊瑚粉色。 新梢可显现美丽的珊瑚粉色，叶形会让人联想到 Acer buergerianum。 该常绿种实际上与三角枫关系密切，同属 Pentaphylla 组。 Acer paxii 在 10 年内可长至 15-20 英尺。 在较温暖地区，建议避开午后烈日。 若想为花园增添一份稀有性与独特性，这是一个值得收藏的罕见槭树品种。
